name: Soft Robotics
description: Soft actuators: History, current status, and infrastructure; Natural and artificial muscles; Smart materials for soft actuators; Hyperelasticity: Viscoelasticity; Modeling techniques of soft mechanics; Mechanics of soft elastomeric materials; Soft sensors (Fluidic, solid, composites, textiles); Fabrication recipes for soft machines; Applications of soft machines in different possible areas; Fabrication of soft robot subsystems using 3D printing and elastomer (silicon) casting; Mechanical characterization of silicone rubber; Soft manipulator arms; Soft gripper fabrication and testing; Fludo-Jelly fabrication (Jellyfish-like soft robot enabled by soft pneumatic composite); Pneumatic wrist brace fabrication and testing; Fabrication and testing of fiber-braided soft actuator
